test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

LOYALTY
solution: The correct answer is '**Faithfulness**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • ** Loyalty** means '**faithfulness to commitments or obligations' (**प्रतिबद्धताओं या दायित्वों के प्रति वफादारी). • ***Example***:*** Loyalty*** *means in a relationship, being patient, open, and communicative to your partner.* • *​*Marked option '​**Faithfulness'** means the 'concept of unfailingly remaining loyal to someone or something'(वफ़ादारी). • ***Example***: *Matrimonial vows are to show the** faithfulness** of the new couple.* • *​*It is clear that ***Loyalty*** and ***Faithfulness*** are similar in meaning. • **Therefore, **the correct answer is **option 2.****​** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • ** Hatred: **a very strong feeling of not liking somebody/something; hate.(व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए अत्‍यधिक नापसंदगी का भाव; घृणा) • ** Dislike: **to think that somebody/something is unpleasant(नापसंद करना) • ** Pleasure: **the feeling of being happy or satisfied(प्रसन्‍नता या संतुष्टि) 33:T55d, The correct answer is **"had to"**
